newsitem.title: USA: Heinz says on track for double-digit growth.
newsitem.headline: Heinz says on track for double-digit growth.

text.p: H.J. Heinz Co is on track to meet its goal of posting double-digit earnings growth in fiscal year 1997, said William Johnson, president and chief operating officer.
Johnson also said he is comfortable with Wall Street's estimate range for the year of $1.88 to $1.95 per share. "I think we're comfortable with the current projections," he told Reuters.
The mean estimate for the year is $1.91 per share. For fiscal year 1996, Heinz posted earnings of $1.75 per share.

Johnson declined to comment on projections for the current fiscal third quarter, which ends January 31. The mean estimate for the quarter is $0.47 per share, based on 15 estimates ranging from $0.44 to $0.50 per share.
In last year's fiscal third quarter, Heinz earned $0.42 per share.
